item: Distinct Tor isolation tokens ask for distinct circuits: Wikidata lookups and download segments no longer share one (queue item 50(a))
summary: Queue item 50(a), an R621 follow-up recorded by Export with no PR planned; taken at the coordinator's request after #1913. BEFORE: src.safety.fetcher._with_stream_isolation named a token's Tor circuit (Tor's IsolateSOCKSAuth builds one circuit per SOCKS credential) by the token stripped to [A-Za-z0-9_.-] and cut at 32 characters, so tokens that agreed on their first 32 kept characters shared one credential and one circuit, against the claims of their callers. Measured on main 1d1204bfd with the callers' own URL builders: four Wikidata lookups (wikidata_rings.wbsearch_url and wbentities_url, the ring loader's tokens; the ring loader's and the catalogue apply's docstrings say each lookup or request rides its own circuit) gave 1 credential; the 36 dump URLs of the twelve UI editions times three kinds gave 12 (the kinds of one wiki shared); 8 segments of one dump or one OSM region (segmented_download.default_fetch_segment's url#seg-a-b tokens, which wiki dumps and OSM downloads use and whose docstring says each segment rides its own circuit) gave 1; a name with no kept character (a Unicode token) read 'oo', and host:port read the same as hostport. The 9 OSM region URLs already gave 9, and the 5,540 hosts of the bundled catalogues already gave 5,540 per-host credentials (the fetcher's own token is the host key), so a source's own circuit was not affected in the bundled catalogues. NOW: _isolation_credential(token) uses a token as written when it is at most 32 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_.-] (a host key, dl-1: unchanged), and names any other token by 'oo.' and the first 32 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the WHOLE token (128 bits, 35 characters, so it can never equal an as-written credential); the same token keeps the same credential run after run, credentials a caller set and non-SOCKS proxies are left alone as before, and a URL token's path and query no longer reach the proxy URL (they used to, cut at 32). TESTS: tests/test_isolation_credential_item50.py, 14, through the callers' own URL builders, the segmented download's own fetch with the guarded factory replaced, and the fetcher's own per-host proxies; on 1d1204bfd 10 fail and the 4 that pin unchanged behaviour pass. MUTANTS: 8, all killed (the as-written bound raised, a digest of the first 32 characters, of the stripped token, without the prefix, shortened, no character check, search for fullmatch, the old rule back). NOT CHANGED, stated: Tor decides what a circuit is; this only makes distinct tokens ask for distinct circuits; IsolateSOCKSAuth must be on in the operator's Tor (it is by default); an HTTP proxy still cannot isolate. Release-notes line: «Over Tor, each Wikidata lookup and each segment of a download now rides its own circuit, as the app already said: lookups to one site, and the segments of one file, could share one.»
